body:
Can you split this up so that the bug fixes are separate from the new features? 

Each bug fix should be its own PR and each feature should be in its own PR. The way they are mixed up together here makes it impossible to do a fair review. 

See our guidelines for more info https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/pull_requests/pull_request_guidelines.html#contribute-one-change-at-a-time

> Can you split this up so that the bug fixes are separate from the new features?
> 
> Each bug fix should be its own PR and each feature should be in its own PR. The way they are mixed up together here makes it impossible to do a fair review.
> 

Yeah let me explain: All the changes are layered mean that each other depends of each other so cannot be split, and most of them are at the same time a fix and addition because someone totally missed to inject them into the baker.

So the visibility check excludes the mesh, the second shadow one excludes the mesh also from the shadow pass, the double sided shadow add a permutation to the pass, then the contribute bool excludes also the mesh from the baker, the emissive excludes it from the baker too. So technically is a single pass with many different bools passing across the same files that cannot be splitted more as them all depend of each other like a layered onion.

In resume basically just exclude the rendering of the mesh in the baker in different ways, options, layers. So it gives the control to the artist, enabling the missing shadow and visibility options that should be exposed and adding the extra two emissive layer exclusion and contribution to others.

Visibility (Exposed): Self defined, just turn on off the whole mesh for the baker.
Shadow (Exposed): Self defined it just allow to bake or not the shadow cast from given mesh.
Double Sided Shadow (Exposed & Addition) once mesh is disabled option, self explanatory.
Emissive (Addition): It affects other meshes and self bouncing light using its emissive material.
Contribution (Addition): Itself contribution to the general bake, say will light bounce on it or not etc.
Receive (Addition): Will have shadowmap itself?
